      "type": "string",
      "description": "Workspace-relative path where this spec is written on disk (e.g. docs/specs/SPEC-001.json). Set by the scribe skill orchestrator after gate passes. Agents resolve it against workspace_root from the recon manifest."
    },
    "revision_note": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Set when this spec is a correction of a previously gated spec, typically sourced from a implementer spec_contradiction report. Describes what changed and why, citing the affected criterion_id. Absent on first drafts."
    },
    "reasoning": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Agent scratchpad — not consumed downstream"
    }
  }
}
# Global tasks inherited by every project (all crates use the rust toolchain uniformly).
tasks:
  build:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["build", "-p", "$project"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  test:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["test", "-p", "$project"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "**/*.snap"
      - "**/*.trycmd"

  lint:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["clippy", "-p", "$project", "--all-targets", "--", "-D", "warnings"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  format:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["fmt", "-p", "$project"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  format-check:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["fmt", "-p", "$project", "--", "--check"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  audit:
    command: "cargo-deny"
    args: ["check", "advisories"]
    inputs:
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  publish:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["publish", "-p", "$project", "--no-verify"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@53165ef7e734c5c07cb06b3c8e7b647c5aa16db3 # v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: '1.58.0'

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@e67fa11c4b9316fa714ddf0abed07a0c3143b95b # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: WASM Target Check
        run: just wasm-check

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@e67fa11c4b9316fa714ddf0abed07a0c3143b95b # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Reject mutable GitHub Actions references
        run: .github/tests/verify-action-pins.sh

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # This workspace bumps interdependent Cargo packages together, so a
          # bumped member's own Cargo.lock entry goes stale without this --
          # see ARCHITECTURE.md's "Lockfile Staleness" section.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, version-pr]
    if: needs.version-pr.outputs.has_pending_changesets == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
    steps:
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}/pulls" --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            echo 'is_release_pr=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json --out release-intent.json
          shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: |
            release-intent.json
            release-intent.json.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  build:
    name: Build the intent-bound source tree
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@53165ef7e734c5c07cb06b3c8e7b647c5aa16db3 # v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: '1.58.0'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: .release-handoff
      - name: Verify handoff and build
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd .release-handoff && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input .release-handoff/release-intent.json
          mkdir -p release-artifacts
          just build
      - name: Attest declared binary artifacts
        if: hashFiles('release-artifacts/**') != ''
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: release-artifacts/**
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-build
          # include-hidden-files: upload-artifact excludes dotfiles by
          # default, and .release-handoff is one -- without this it silently
          # uploads nothing and "execute" downloads an empty artifact.
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            .release-handoff
            release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  environment-policy:
    name: Verify release Environment protection
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Require release Environment reviewers
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          reviewers=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/environments/release" --jq '.protection_rules // [] | map(select(.type == "required_reviewers")) | length')
          [[ "$reviewers" != 0 ]] || { echo '::error::GitHub Environment release has no required-reviewers protection rule'; exit 1; }

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: environment-policy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Unlike every other job's checkout, this one must persist
          # credentials: dispatch_tag (callisto-graph) pushes the release tag
          # with a plain `git push`, which has no other way to authenticate.
          # This job's own contents: write permission (above) is what backs it.
          persist-credentials: true
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          # .release-handoff and release-artifacts were sibling upload paths
          # in "build", so upload-artifact rooted the archive one level up --
          # the handoff file lands here nested under .release-handoff/, not
          # flat at release-intent.json.
          cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/.release-handoff/release-intent.json"
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TWINE_PASSWORD }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          state_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-state/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$state_dir"
          args=(--intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --state "$state_dir/execution-state.json")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Verify permissions that GitHub only enforces when a guarded release path is
# actually exercised. Keeping this separate from the generic action-pin check
# makes the release authority contract visible and testable on every PR.
set -euo pipefail

workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml

job_block() {
  local job="$1" next_job="$2"
  sed -n "/^  ${job}:$/,/^  ${next_job}:$/p" "$workflow"
}

require_line() {
  local block="$1" expected="$2" description="$3"
  if ! grep -Fqx "$expected" <<< "$block"; then
    printf 'release workflow contract failed: %s\n' "$description" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

version_pr="$(job_block version-pr release-candidate)"
require_line "$version_pr" '      contents: write' 'version-pr must write the managed branch'
require_line "$version_pr" '      pull-requests: write' 'version-pr must create or update the release PR'
require_line "$version_pr" "          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'" 'this workspace bumps interdependent Cargo packages together -- without --refresh-lockfiles, Cargo.lock goes stale on every version bump and the next plain `cargo build` dirties the release worktree'

release_candidate="$(job_block release-candidate plan)"
require_line "$release_candidate" '          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}/pulls" --jq '\''[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length'\'')' 'release-candidate must accept only canonical or SHA-suffixed managed branches'

build="$(job_block build environment-policy)"
require_line "$build" '      contents: read' 'build must read the intent-bound source tree'
require_line "$build" '      attestations: write' 'build must create provenance attestations'
require_line "$build" '      id-token: write' 'build must mint the Sigstore OIDC identity'
require_line "$build" '          include-hidden-files: true' 'build must upload .release-handoff -- upload-artifact drops dotfiles by default and "execute" would silently receive nothing'

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '          cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/.release-handoff/release-intent.json"' 'execute must read the handoff file at its actual archived path -- .release-handoff and release-artifacts were sibling upload paths in "build", so the artifact is rooted one level up, not flattened'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent' 'execute must download release-intent outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build' 'execute must download release-build outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'

ci_workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml
checkout_count=$(rg -n 'uses: actions/checkout@' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
credential_free_checkout_count=$(rg -n 'persist-credentials: false' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
if [[ "$checkout_count" != "$credential_free_checkout_count" ]]; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: every Callisto CI checkout must disable persisted credentials\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

require_line "$version_pr" '          persist-credentials: false' 'version-pr never git-pushes -- it commits through the forge API -- so it must not persist Git credentials'

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '          persist-credentials: true' 'execute pushes the release tag with a plain git push (dispatch_tag) -- unlike every other job it has no other way to authenticate, so it must persist Git credentials'

if rg -U 'run: \|(?s:.*?)\$\{\{ inputs\.' .github/actions/setup-callisto/action.yml .github/actions/setup-callisto-wasm/action.yml > /dev/null; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: composite-action inputs must enter shell through named environment variables\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

{
  "goal": "Converge every immutable release operation against exact provider state and return a persisted receipt only after complete external verification.",
  "architecture": "The plan keeps durable, provider-neutral exact evidence and receipts in callisto-model, canonical remote Git behavior in callisto-vcs, and provider protocol interpretation plus convergence in callisto-graph. ValidatedReleaseIntent and a validated artifact capability remain the only graph-private inputs to observation and effects; the journal and receipts remain output diagnostics rather than external authority. The CLI only validates inputs, invokes graph convergence or read-only reconciliation, and renders the typed result.",
  "tech_stack": [
    "Rust",
    "callisto-model",
    "callisto-vcs",
    "callisto-graph",
    "callisto-cli",
    "CommandRunner",
    "GitDataSource and GitAccess",
    "GitHub CLI",
    "local HTTP registry fixtures",
    "just"
  ],
  "linked_spec": "SPEC-RELEASE-CONVERGENCE-002",
  "spec_file_path": "docs/specs/SPEC-RELEASE-CONVERGENCE-002.json",
  "plan_file_path": "docs/projects/SPEC-RELEASE-CONVERGENCE-002.json",
  "spec_hash": "sha256:ed5c36eabbd88760016b75a72e2c8c8184ecc0d9af9adf307c639f8fce7b656e",
  "linked_requirement": "REQ-DRAFT-RELEASE-RECOVERY",
  "reasoning": "SPEC-RELEASE-PRODUCT-MODEL-001 is a hard prerequisite: this plan consumes its replacement product release, operation, registry-artifact-slot, and product-asset-slot contracts without retaining the current package-owned compatibility path. The shared GitDataSource inventory is GitRepository, ShellGit, and GitAccess; all three are covered by task 2. The prepared operation is graph-private, so provider observation belongs in graph, while serializable exact evidence belongs in model.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T1",
      "title": "Add strict durable exact-observation evidence and receipt schemas",
      "files": {
        "modify": [
          "crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs"
        ],
        "test": [
          "crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs"
        ]
      },
      "steps": [
        "After SPEC-RELEASE-PRODUCT-MODEL-001 has replaced the release identities, implement its already-gated ReleaseObservationEvidence variants and the strict versioned ReleaseReceipt wire/domain schema in crates/callisto-model/src/release.rs.",
        "Require canonical operation ordering, exact intent-digest and operation-roster binding, role-matched safe identity/digest/byte-length evidence, and newly-produced versus already-present provenance; reject endpoints, credentials, headers, provider stderr, arbitrary strings, and mutable configuration from durable evidence.",
        "Replace the current state-only ReleaseReceiptV1::from_state completion route with construction from a complete exact observation roster; retain ReleaseExecutionStateV1 only as diagnostic input and never as external proof.",
        "Add model tests for unknown fields, duplicate or missing operation entries, non-canonical ordering, mismatched evidence identity, mismatched intent digest, unsafe evidence, and canonical round-trip of complete exact receipts containing both provenance outcomes.",
        "Run just fmt-check && just lint && just test; expect all workspace checks to pass and receipt construction to reject every non-exact or malformed roster."
      ],
      "commit_message": "feat(model): add versioned release observation evidence",
      "depends_on": [
        "SPEC-RELEASE-PRODUCT-MODEL-001"
      ],
      "covers_criteria": [
        "AC-005"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T2",
      "title": "Expose canonical remote annotated-tag observation and confirmation",
      "files": {
        "modify": [
          "crates/callisto-vcs/src/lib.rs",
          "crates/callisto-vcs/src/access.rs",
          "crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs"
        ],
        "test": [
          "crates/callisto-vcs/src/access.rs",
          "crates/callisto-vcs/src/shell.rs"
        ]
      },
      "steps": [
        "Extend GitDataSource with the remote annotated-tag read and push-confirmation operations required by the gated convergence contract, carrying configured remote identity, tag name, target commit, and annotation digest.",
        "Implement the contract in GitRepository, ShellGit, and GitAccess so native/shell selection preserves typed absent, exact, conflict, and VCS failure semantics; retain local tag creation through existing GitAccess and remove no caller yet.",
        "Add temporary-bare-remote tests for absent, exact annotated tag, target conflict, annotation conflict, a local-only matching tag, successful push followed by exact remote readback, and command failure.",
        "Run just fmt-check && just lint && just test; expect a local-only tag never to count as exact and remote conflict or transport failure to remain distinguishable."
      ],
      "commit_message": "feat(vcs): observe and verify remote release tags",
      "depends_on": [
        "SPEC-RELEASE-PRODUCT-MODEL-001"
      ],
      "covers_criteria": [
        "AC-007"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T3",
      "title": "Bind artifact validation and unify graph provider observation",
      "files": {
        "create": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_observation.rs"
        ],
        "modify": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_artifacts.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/mod.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/error.rs"
        ],
        "test": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_artifacts.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_observation.rs"
        ]
      },
      "steps": [
        "Change the artifact-validation constructor in release_artifacts.rs to require ValidatedReleaseIntent and return the non-serializable validated artifact capability bound to that exact intent; remove execution acceptance of a raw artifact manifest after validation.",
        "Implement the gated closed graph-only OperationObservation and ExternalConflict taxonomy plus observe_prepared in release_observation.rs; dispatch exhaustively over every graph-private prepared operation and convert only exact proof to model ReleaseObservationEvidence.",
        "Implement registry artifact observation against SPEC-001's validated manifest: crates.io-compatible checksum, npm packed tarball integrity or bytes, and PyPI named distribution SHA-256; classify exact subsets with only verified missing work as Incomplete and classify different or unprovable bytes as Conflict or Unverifiable.",
        "Use task T2 GitAccess/GitDataSource remote operations for tag observation and post-push confirmation instead of release.rs local rev-parse/for-each-ref logic.",
        "Use supported gh API arguments for GitHub Release and asset observation; classify real nonzero 404 as Absent, preserve 401/403/429/5xx/timeout/malformed output as Unverifiable, use separately verified remote-tag identity rather than target_commitish, and distinguish ForgePrepare draft/published-successor exactness from ForgePublish asset-roster completion.",
        "Add focused CommandRunner tests for all observation outcomes, registry exact/incomplete/conflict/unverifiable values, supported gh argv, nonzero 404, and GitHub Release/asset exactness rules.",
        "Run just fmt-check && just lint && just test; expect every prepared role to produce exactly one closed observation result and no graph sibling observer to treat local Git or target_commitish as authority."
      ],
      "commit_message": "feat(graph): add unified release provider observation",
      "depends_on": [
        "T1",
        "T2"
      ],
      "covers_criteria": [
        "AC-001",
        "AC-006",
        "AC-008",
        "AC-009",
        "AC-013"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T4",
      "title": "Converge execution from observations and atomically persist receipts",
      "files": {
        "create": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_receipt_store.rs"
        ],
        "modify": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_execution.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_store.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/mod.rs"
        ],
        "test": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_execution.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_store.rs",
          "crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_receipt_store.rs"
        ]
      },
      "steps": [
        "Replace Pending-only reconcile_release_execution with the gated complete canonical-DAG observation report that invokes task T3's observer exactly once per operation, requires no ApplyPermit, and does not reach any mutation route.",
        "Replace execute_release_with_artifacts with convergence over the validated artifact capability: observe prerequisites and operations in canonical order regardless of saved Pending, Attempting, Published, AlreadySatisfied, Failed, or Blocked state; mutate only Absent or the verified missing work of Incomplete once per invocation; then re-observe as Exact.",
        "Persist state transitions atomically through ReleaseStateStore only as intent-bound diagnostics; missing, stale, unreadable, or lost state must neither widen authority nor prevent fresh observation recovery.",
        "Add explicit-path ReleaseReceiptStore as the sole production writer, backed by callisto_model::atomic::atomic_write, and persist/return a receipt only after one final complete exact observation pass. Do not read a receipt as proof on a later run.",
        "Add tests for recovery from Attempting, Failed, Blocked, and absent journal states; non-exact prerequisite gating; one-attempt-per-invocation behavior; final-pass completeness; atomic state/receipt write failure; and structurally read-only reconciliation.",
        "Run just fmt-check && just lint && just test; expect no successful return for incomplete state, and every success to have a matching atomically persisted receipt."
      ],
      "commit_message": "feat(graph): converge releases from provider state",
      "depends_on": [
        "T3"
      ],
      "covers_criteria": [
        "AC-002",
        "AC-003",
        "AC-004",
        "AC-005",
        "AC-010"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T5",
      "title": "Expose convergence and complete reconciliation through the CLI",
      "files": {
        "modify": [
          "crates/callisto-cli/src/cli.rs",
          "crates/callisto-cli/src/commands/release.rs",
          "crates/callisto-cli/src/error.rs"
        ],
        "test": [
          "crates/callisto-cli/tests/durable_release_e2e_tests.rs",
          "crates/callisto-cli/tests/dry_run_invariant_tests.rs"
        ]
      },
      "steps": [
        "Require the graph-validated artifact capability before execute or reconcile whenever the immutable intent has slots, and route execute to T4 convergence rather than returning raw ReleaseExecutionStateV1.",
        "Route reconcile to the complete graph observation report, render all operation observations in JSON and text, and make every absent, incomplete, conflict, unverifiable, pending, attempting, failed, blocked, missing receipt, or receipt-write failure a nonzero exit with operation identity and recovery action.",
        "Add CLI tests proving successful execute renders a persisted receipt, JSON retains complete typed observations, incomplete reconciliation exits nonzero, and reconcile cannot obtain a permit or reach registry publish, Git push, GitHub creation, or upload routes.",
        "Run just fmt-check && just lint && just test; expect no CLI success merely because no locally Pending operation remains."
      ],
      "commit_message": "feat(cli): report converged release receipts",
      "depends_on": [
        "T4"
      ],
      "covers_criteria": [
        "AC-004",
        "AC-010",
        "AC-013"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "T6",
      "title": "Exercise realistic provider and interruption-resume convergence boundaries",
      "files": {
        "create": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/tests/release_convergence_boundary_tests.rs",
          "crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_convergence_e2e_tests.rs"
        ],
        "test": [
          "crates/callisto-graph/tests/release_convergence_boundary_tests.rs",
          "crates/callisto-cli/tests/release_convergence_e2e_tests.rs"
        ]
      },
      "steps": [
        "Build real temporary bare-Git-remote cases for absent, exact, conflicting, and local-only tags, then assert fresh-runner execution reads the remote and does not duplicate an exact effect.",
        "Use argv-sensitive gh fixtures matching installed gh parsing and model real nonzero 404 plus 401, 403, 429, and 5xx responses; assert absence is distinct from unverifiable failure and an exit-zero-only or argv-insensitive fake cannot satisfy the tests.",
        "Use local HTTP registry fixtures for absent, exact, conflicting, and unverifiable artifact metadata and assert only the verified missing registry artifacts are submitted.",
        "Interrupt at attempt persistence, every independently uploadable artifact, provider success, post-effect observation, terminal-state persistence, and receipt persistence; resume once with the journal and once without it on a fresh runner.",
        "Assert every resume either produces only verified missing work and the same complete receipt or exits nonzero for conflict/unverifiable input; assert no scenario returns a successful incomplete state.",
        "Run just fmt-check && just lint && just test; expect all real-contract and interruption-resume boundary cases to pass."
      ],
      "commit_message": "test(release): cover convergence provider boundaries",
      "depends_on": [
        "T4",
        "T5"
      ],
      "covers_criteria": [
        "AC-001",
        "AC-002",
        "AC-003",
        "AC-006",
        "AC-007",
        "AC-008",
        "AC-009",
        "AC-011",
        "AC-012"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "batches": [
    {
      "batch_id": "B1",
      "title": "Provider-neutral evidence and canonical remote Git primitives",
      "target_crate": "callisto-model and callisto-vcs",
      "task_ids": [
        "T1",
        "T2"
      ]
    },
    {
      "batch_id": "B2",
      "title": "Graph provider observation and convergence",
      "target_crate": "callisto-graph",
      "task_ids": [
        "T3",
        "T4"
      ]
    },
    {
      "batch_id": "B3",
      "title": "CLI reporting and end-to-end boundary verification",
      "target_crate": "callisto-cli and callisto-graph tests",
      "task_ids": [
        "T5",
        "T6"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

# Global tasks inherited by every project (all crates use the rust toolchain uniformly).
tasks:
  build:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["build", "-p", "$project"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  test:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["test", "-p", "$project"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "**/*.snap"
      - "**/*.trycmd"

  lint:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["clippy", "-p", "$project", "--all-targets", "--", "-D", "warnings"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  format:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["fmt", "-p", "$project"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  format-check:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["fmt", "-p", "$project", "--", "--check"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "tests/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  audit:
    command: "cargo-deny"
    args: ["check", "advisories"]
    inputs:
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "Cargo.toml"

  publish:
    command: "cargo"
    args: ["publish", "-p", "$project", "--no-verify"]
    inputs:
      - "src/**/*"
      - "Cargo.toml"
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: extractions/setup-just@53165ef7e734c5c07cb06b3c8e7b647c5aa16db3 # v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: '1.58.0'

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@e67fa11c4b9316fa714ddf0abed07a0c3143b95b # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: WASM Target Check
        run: just wasm-check

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@e67fa11c4b9316fa714ddf0abed07a0c3143b95b # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Reject mutable GitHub Actions references
        run: .github/tests/verify-action-pins.sh

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # This workspace bumps interdependent Cargo packages together, so a
          # bumped member's own Cargo.lock entry goes stale without this --
          # see ARCHITECTURE.md's "Lockfile Staleness" section.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, version-pr]
    if: needs.version-pr.outputs.has_pending_changesets == 'false'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
    steps:
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}/pulls" --jq '[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$prs" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            echo 'is_release_pr=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    if: needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release plan --from-release-commit "$GITHUB_SHA" --decision .callisto/release-decision.json --out release-intent.json
          shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: |
            release-intent.json
            release-intent.json.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  build:
    name: Build the intent-bound source tree
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: extractions/setup-just@53165ef7e734c5c07cb06b3c8e7b647c5aa16db3 # v4.0.0
        with:
          just-version: '1.58.0'
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: .release-handoff
      - name: Verify handoff and build
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          (cd .release-handoff && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input .release-handoff/release-intent.json
          mkdir -p release-artifacts
          just build
      - name: Attest declared binary artifacts
        if: hashFiles('release-artifacts/**') != ''
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: release-artifacts/**
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: release-build
          # include-hidden-files: upload-artifact excludes dotfiles by
          # default, and .release-handoff is one -- without this it silently
          # uploads nothing and "execute" downloads an empty artifact.
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            .release-handoff
            release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 1

  environment-policy:
    name: Verify release Environment protection
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Require release Environment reviewers
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          reviewers=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/environments/release" --jq '.protection_rules // [] | map(select(.type == "required_reviewers")) | length')
          [[ "$reviewers" != 0 ]] || { echo '::error::GitHub Environment release has no required-reviewers protection rule'; exit 1; }

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: environment-policy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: release
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          # Unlike every other job's checkout, this one must persist
          # credentials: dispatch_tag (callisto-graph) pushes the release tag
          # with a plain `git push`, which has no other way to authenticate.
          # This job's own contents: write permission (above) is what backs it.
          persist-credentials: true
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          # .release-handoff and release-artifacts were sibling upload paths
          # in "build", so upload-artifact rooted the archive one level up --
          # the handoff file lands here nested under .release-handoff/, not
          # flat at release-intent.json.
          cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/.release-handoff/release-intent.json"
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
          TWINE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.TWINE_PASSWORD }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          state_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-state/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$state_dir"
          args=(--intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --state "$state_dir/execution-state.json")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Verify permissions that GitHub only enforces when a guarded release path is
# actually exercised. Keeping this separate from the generic action-pin check
# makes the release authority contract visible and testable on every PR.
set -euo pipefail

workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml

job_block() {
  local job="$1" next_job="$2"
  sed -n "/^  ${job}:$/,/^  ${next_job}:$/p" "$workflow"
}

require_line() {
  local block="$1" expected="$2" description="$3"
  if ! grep -Fqx "$expected" <<< "$block"; then
    printf 'release workflow contract failed: %s\n' "$description" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
}

version_pr="$(job_block version-pr release-candidate)"
require_line "$version_pr" '      contents: write' 'version-pr must write the managed branch'
require_line "$version_pr" '      pull-requests: write' 'version-pr must create or update the release PR'
require_line "$version_pr" "          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'" 'this workspace bumps interdependent Cargo packages together -- without --refresh-lockfiles, Cargo.lock goes stale on every version bump and the next plain `cargo build` dirties the release worktree'

release_candidate="$(job_block release-candidate plan)"
require_line "$release_candidate" '          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${GITHUB_SHA}/pulls" --jq '\''[.[] | select(.merged_at != null and .base.ref == "main" and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$"))))] | length'\'')' 'release-candidate must accept only canonical or SHA-suffixed managed branches'

build="$(job_block build environment-policy)"
require_line "$build" '      contents: read' 'build must read the intent-bound source tree'
require_line "$build" '      attestations: write' 'build must create provenance attestations'
require_line "$build" '      id-token: write' 'build must mint the Sigstore OIDC identity'
require_line "$build" '          include-hidden-files: true' 'build must upload .release-handoff -- upload-artifact drops dotfiles by default and "execute" would silently receive nothing'

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '          cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/.release-handoff/release-intent.json"' 'execute must read the handoff file at its actual archived path -- .release-handoff and release-artifacts were sibling upload paths in "build", so the artifact is rooted one level up, not flattened'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent' 'execute must download release-intent outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build' 'execute must download release-build outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'

ci_workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml
checkout_count=$(rg -n 'uses: actions/checkout@' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
credential_free_checkout_count=$(rg -n 'persist-credentials: false' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
if [[ "$checkout_count" != "$credential_free_checkout_count" ]]; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: every Callisto CI checkout must disable persisted credentials\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

require_line "$version_pr" '          persist-credentials: false' 'version-pr never git-pushes -- it commits through the forge API -- so it must not persist Git credentials'

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '          persist-credentials: true' 'execute pushes the release tag with a plain git push (dispatch_tag) -- unlike every other job it has no other way to authenticate, so it must persist Git credentials'

if rg -U 'run: \|(?s:.*?)\$\{\{ inputs\.' .github/actions/setup-callisto/action.yml .github/actions/setup-callisto-wasm/action.yml > /dev/null; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: composite-action inputs must enter shell through named environment variables\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi
"}
